issue.body:
## I'm submitting a... 

[x] Regression (a behavior that used to work and stopped working in a new release)
[ ] Bug report  
[ ] Feature request
[ ] Documentation issue or request
[ ] Support request => Please do not submit support request here, instead see https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#question
## Current behavior ```js function y(t, e, n) { 'string' != typeof e && (n = e, e = t[0]), e = e.toLowerCase().replace(/_/g, '-'), d[e] = t, n && (d[e][19] = n) } ``` `TypeError: e is undefined[Learn More] main.8d50cd235bdedd34ad5a.js:formatted:7106` ## Expected behavior Compiling application in production mode with `i18nLocale` set runs built app successfully with selected locale. ## Minimal reproduction of the problem with instructions ```bash $ ng new test-app ``` In `package.json` set angular dependencies to `6.0.0-rc.0` and rxjs to `6.0.0-beta.4` and typescript to `2.7.2` ```bash $ npm i ``` In `angular.json`, modify production configuration to have `i18nLocale: 'ja'`, or any other locale besides en. ```bash $ ng serve --configuration=production ``` Open to `locahost:4200` and see broken application with the error `TypeError: e is undefined[Learn More] main.8d50cd235bdedd34ad5a.js:formatted:7106` ## What is the motivation / use case for changing the behavior? Angular 6 works built with a different locale ## Environment 

Angular version: >=6.0.0-rc.0 (possibly the beta releases, I haven't tried them)

Browser:
all browsers
 
Others:
Application works correctly in dev mode, but breaks with optimizations on.

This is the source file it is coming from: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/packages/common/src/i18n/locale_data.ts#L27
